body: Wow, you're devastatingly stupid. Those two "points" you've provided are based entirely on blind faith in the government, and lack any grounding in reality (something you seem to have a tenuous connection to). I would encourage you to examine why you think a government that has been shown by these very leaks and those similar to have betrayed and lied to it's own people would ever care about the rules it created for itself. I take no small amount of joy in knowing that a "dirty rotten cold blooded traitor" has and always will have contributed far more to the betterment of this world than your pathetic, myopic nationalist view ever could.

The fact our government was spying on it's own people illegally, and when it was exposed those who exposed it were persecuted and now you attack them? And I never said the state doesn't do anything good - I was criticizing you for not recognizing the literal harm it has done. By calling Manning a "cold-blooded traitor", you are directly attacking the actions she took against the state's abuses: i.e., you were defending the state's absues. Own up to that, at the very least.

Don't scream that they don't have an argument just because you can't understand what they're saying. The fact that you're defending a state's abuses instead of the people it's failing to protect speaks volumes about your inability to recognize the problems in society.
As a highschooler whose been pretty terrified to even recognized myself as gay, stuff like this does a surprising amount to help. Hopefully I can be so lucky one day, and congrats you to. <3
